substantiveReasons: Repository observation: the production-source diff from d837620 is exactly one imports K-EQUAL line in expression-json.k. The only other implementation change adds an offline import assertion. All seven other expression modules, 115 fixtures, TypeScript, codec, parser and runner remain unchanged.

Its equality hooks and inequality rule provide the generic term equality already intended by the existing expressions. All eight expression modules reach K-EQUAL through public imports.

Independent diagnostic check: all 41 retained diagnostic locations map to generic equality operators in the exact pre-repair source: 25 ==K, four =/=K, ten partial equals tokens within ==K, and two slash scanner errors within =/=K. Missing equality grammar consistently explains every reported location. This supports the repair hypothesis without establishing that compilation will succeed or reveal no further errors.

No concrete additional blocker was found within this repair scope. Prior passing source audits were inspected as historical evidence, not substituted for reviewing the current changed bytes.

Arithmetic matches 180 + 115*20 + 72 = 2552 seconds and a 2588-second outer envelope.

Accounting observation: the failed compile remains charged, preserving cumulative seven compile attempts and 113 krun invocations. Its recorded compiler time is 7.81964657100616 seconds and outer elapsed time is 8.01 seconds. All six inventoried artifacts still match in the retained original build directory; the new worktree has no expression build directory. This is a justified new grammar experiment, not an automatic retry or refund.
